hotel_name: JW Marriott Hotel Singapore South Beach

claims.text: The hotel sits near Marina Bay within Singapore's Central Business District, near the National Stadium and National Gallery.

findings.quote: Our luxury hotel near Singapore's Marina Bay is ideally situated within the Central Business District (CBD), near leading downtown attractions, including the National Stadium and National Gallery.

claims.text: Arab Street and the Kampong Glam neighborhood are just steps from the hotel.

findings.quote: Located just steps from our hotel, Arab Street and the neighborhood of Kampong Glam were once home to Muslim traders.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the lobby is full of installations and furniture that double as art, including a floor-to-ceiling digital art display.

findings.quote: The lobby is full of installations and furniture that double as art, like a floor-to-ceiling digital art display and antique tables encased within modern glass tables.

claims.text: Deluxe and Premier rooms have marble bathrooms with automatic toilets with electronic bidets and a separate rain shower.

findings.quote: all Deluxe and Premier Marina Bay luxury suites in Singapore are elegantly styled with our signature
marble bathrooms featuring state-of-the-art automatic toilets with electronic bidets and a separate rain shower.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes tablet-controlled curtains, lighting and air conditioning in the room.

findings.quote: the tablet-controlled curtains, lighting, and air conditioning.

claims.text: The Premier Marina Bay View Suite offers panoramic views of Singapore's cityscape.

findings.quote: Wake up to panoramic views of Singapore's cityscape when you book our Premier Marina Bay View Suite

claims.text: Executive Lounge access includes complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.

findings.quote: Pamper yourself further with access to the Executive Lounge during your visit, complete with complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea as well as evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes an edible garden by landscape designer Lily Kwong introduces travelers to local plants such as butterfly pea flower.

findings.quote: An edible garden by landscape designer Lily Kwong offers overseas travelers an introduction to local plants, like the butterfly pea flower

claims.text: Spa by JW treatments are based on Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew and use Aromatherapy Associates products.

findings.quote: signature massage, body and facial treatments based on the key benefits of Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew. Featuring products by Aromatherapy Associates.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the 18th-floor pool has a view of the central business district.

findings.quote: The pool on the 18th floor has a fabulous view of the central business district.

claims.text: Madame Fan serves modern Cantonese cuisine in Art Deco interiors with a destination bar.

findings.quote: showcasing masterfully modern Cantonese cuisine, immersive Art Deco interiors and a destination bar.

claims.text: The NCO Club is a conserved heritage building whose history dates back to the 1950s.

findings.quote: Housed in a 1950s Conserved Heritage Building
The NCO Club's storied history dates back to the 1950s.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the hotel is a Philippe Starck-designed project with ultra-modern rooms.

findings.quote: As can be expected from a Philippe Starck-designed project, everything in the room was ultra modern

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes a multi-million dollar collection of artworks throughout the property.

findings.quote: a multi-million dollar collection of artworks peppers the property.

claims.text: Rooms have the hotel's floating beds, with panoramic views of the Singapore skyline.

findings.quote: Take in panoramic views of the Singapore skyline as you lounge in the comfort of our unique "floating" beds.

claims.text: The JW Garden grows herbs and ingredients used in the hotel's cuisine.

findings.quote: the JW Garden is a serene sanctuary that welcomes guests and grows herbs and ingredients as part of the culinary journey.

claims.text: Spa by JW has a Relaxation Lounge, sauna, steam room and Jacuzzi.

findings.quote: guests are greeted at the Curator's Desk where they are introduced to spa facilities including a Relaxation Lounge, Sauna, Steam Room and Jacuzzi.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the bustling city-center setting may not suit guests seeking a quiet, resort-style retreat.
WhataHotel notes premium urban pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning and location.
